no_feature.reason: Each row's owner feature is checked inside the notify service (see NOTIFICATION_WRITE_ENDPOINTS in webvue_api tests), so marking read keeps working when the owning feature is switched off.

no_capability.reason: Finishes the login of the caller's own pre-authenticated session (auth/totp) or acts only on the caller's own account or profile (/me); no capability applies.
Public branding for the login page (auth='public'): no session, so no capability and no api_handler.

Gated by maintenance_company(request.env), which requires the maintenance capability in its non-operator branch; the branch is conditional on its operator flag (never set by a route), so the analysis does not credit it.
Chat has no capability keys by design: webvue.chat.service requires an active internal WebVue user and limits every row to the caller's conversations.
User-id picker open to any internal user; gated by the registered directory feature and returns id and name only.
Recipient-owned rows: the notify service returns and updates only the caller's own notifications (digests and the caller's personal stages likewise).
The webvue.operation.request/process model checks its operations.* capability inside create(), a stock name the analysis never credits; the route only validates the body.

Charter action: project._webvue_charter_<action> (and _webvue_lock_for_write(require_manage=...)) check pmo.projects.manage or the reviewer role in the model, but _run calls them from a branch, which the analysis does not credit.

Catalog write: the catalog models (webvue_pmo/models/project_charter_reference.py) require manage in create(), write() and unlink() unless the caller is privileged; those are stock names the analysis never credits.
Project policy write: webvue.pmo.settings.set_values raises AccessError unless the caller is a customer administrator; set_values is a stock name the analysis never credits.

Task restore: task._webvue_can_archive() answers 404 (MissingError, not 403) unless the caller may archive the task, then write access is checked; the analysis only credits a 403 or AccessError refusal.
Comment: no capability key; get_record checks read access on the task and mail.thread applies its post access rule in message_post.

Read of a project or task record: get_record or _project checks read access and record visibility (_webvue_check_visible_current / record rules); the data is not capability gated. Known GET readers declare operation scope separately and keep their downstream record checks.

WhatsApp webhook (machine to machine): Meta signs every POST with HMAC-SHA256 over the raw body and the GET handshake carries the channel verify token; the route runs as the inactive inbox hook identity that may only read channels and create raw events, so there is no user to hold a capability.

no_api_handler.reason: auth='public' branding read: serves the login page and has no session or error mapping to apply.
